components.summary: 求两条曲线的交点。

detail.concept: 求两条曲线的交点。它是布尔、裁剪、分析类操作的输入来源；交点数量不确定是它最大的特点。
steps: 输出交点，可能为零个、一个或多个。

scenes.title: 找路径交叉口
scenes.body: 求两组路网的交点，作为节点位置。
scenes.wiring: 曲线 A + B → 求交 → 节点

pitfalls: 交点数量变化会让下游数据结构跟着变，接列表操作时要注意。
两条曲线仅仅相切时可能返回一个或零个点，取决于容差。
detail.tip: 交点数量不可预期时，先把结果接 Panel 看一眼再往下接。

scenes.title: 定位剖面交点
scenes.body: 用一条垂直参考线切过轮廓，拿到准确的交点位置。
scenes.wiring: 轮廓 + 参考线 → Intersection → 定位

pitfalls: 直线是无限延长的，交点可能落在你画的线段之外。
相切时交点退化成一点或为空。
detail.tip: 求交后按参数排序，顺序对了连线才不会打结。

scenes.title: 找到落地点
scenes.body: 把竖向路径与地形曲面求交，得到准确的落地标高。
scenes.wiring: 竖向线 + 地形 → Curve Surface Intersection → 落地点

pitfalls: 曲线完全贴在曲面上时可能有无数交点，结果不稳定。
交点是点数据，需要砍断曲线得再接 Split 类组件。
detail.tip: 求交后一定按参数排序，交点的顺序直接决定后续连线是否打结。

scenes.title: 找屋面与墙面的交线
scenes.body: 坡屋面与垂直外墙求交，得到天沟所在的三维线。
scenes.wiring: 屋面 + 外墙 → Surface Intersection → 天沟

pitfalls: 两张面只是相切时交线退化成一点或为空。
完全重合的面没有离散交线，结果不可用。
detail.tip: 交线先 Join，再判断是否闭合，能立刻发现曲面是否真的贯穿。

components.info: Create a region from a sequence of bounding planes.

inputs.name: Boundaries
inputs.info: Planes that intersect to create the region boundaries.

outputs.name: Region
outputs.info: Planar region bounded by input planes.

components.summary: 用一组界定平面构造区域。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Dissect Region
components.info: Dissect a region into outer and inner boundary curves.

outputs.name: Outer
outputs.info: List of all outer boundary curves.

outputs.name: Inner
outputs.info: List of all inner boundary, or hole curves.

components.summary: 把区域拆成外边界与内孔边界曲线。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Explode Region
components.info: Explode a region into all disjoint fragments.

outputs.name: Regions
outputs.info: Disjoint fragments of the region.

components.summary: 把区域炸成所有互不相连的片段。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Region Without Holes
components.info: Remove all holes from a region.

outputs.name: Region
outputs.info: Filled region without holes or nested child regions.

outputs.name: Holes
outputs.info: Number of holes removed.

outputs.name: Nested
outputs.info: Number of nested regions removed.

components.summary: 移除区域中的所有孔洞。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Carve Region
components.info: Carve a region into parallel slices using points.

outputs.name: Slices
outputs.info: Resulting region slices.

components.summary: 用一组点把区域切成平行的条块。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Rolling Disc
components.info: Compute the rolling disc coverage of a region.

inputs.name: Point
inputs.info: Optional start point for limiting the rolling disc region.

outputs.name: Coverage
outputs.info: Part of region covered by the disc.

components.summary: 计算用滚动圆盘覆盖区域的结果。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Above Plane
components.info: Test whether a shape is above or below a plane.

outputs.name: Boolean Relation
outputs.info: Boolean relation between shape and plane:¶true = above or coincident¶false = below

outputs.name: Integer Relation
outputs.info: Integer relation between shape and plane:¶1 = above¶0 = coincident¶-1 = below

components.summary: 判断形状位于平面的上方还是下方。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Cut With Plane
components.info: Cut a shape using an infinite plane.

inputs.name: Close
inputs.info: Try to close the cut shape.

outputs.name: Shape
outputs.info: Cut shape.

components.summary: 用无限平面切开一个形状。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Plane Quadrant
components.info: Test in which plane quadrants a shape resides.

outputs.name: Quadrant Indices
outputs.info: List of all plane quadrants that overlap with the shape.

components.summary: 判断形状落在平面的哪个象限。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Rectangle Nonant
components.info: Test in which rectangle nonant regions a shape resides.

outputs.name: Nonant Indices
outputs.info: List of all nonant indices that overlap with the shape.

components.summary: 判断形状落在矩形的哪个九宫格区域。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Curve Containment
components.info: Test whether a point is inside or outside a closed curve.

inputs.name: Curve
inputs.info: Boundary curve. If not closed, a line segment will be inserted to close the curve.

inputs.name: Plane
inputs.info: Optional override for containment testing plane. If omitted, the curve plane is used.

outputs.name: Inside
outputs.info: True if the point is inside the curve.

outputs.name: Outside
outputs.info: True if the point is outside the curve.

components.summary: 判断点是否落在闭合曲线内部。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Curve Relation
components.info: Test the spatial relationship between a curve and a shape, i.e. whether they are disjoint, contain each other, or intersect.

inputs.name: First Shape
inputs.info: First curve or shape for relation test.

inputs.name: Second Shape
inputs.info: Second curve or shape for relation test.

outputs.name: Relation
outputs.info: Containment relationship state:¶{0} = Disjoint¶{1} = A inside B¶{2} = B inside A¶{3} = Intersecting

outputs.name: A Inside B
outputs.info: True if A is fully inside B.

outputs.name: B Inside A
outputs.info: True if B is fully inside A.

components.summary: 判断曲线与形状的空间关系（分离、包含、相交）。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Curve Side
components.info: Test whether a point is to the left or the right of a curve.

inputs.name: Plane
inputs.info: Optional override for testing plane. If omitted, the curve plane is used.

outputs.name: Left
outputs.info: True if the shape is to the left of the curve.

outputs.name: Right
outputs.info: True if the shape is to the right of the curve.

components.summary: 判断点位于曲线的左侧还是右侧。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Half-Space Containment
components.info: Determine whether a point is contained inside one or more half spaces delineated by planes. Containment is taken to mean a negative signed distance. I.e. the plane normal points towards the outside.

inputs.name: Strict
inputs.info: If true, the inclusion is strict.

outputs.name: Inside
outputs.info: True if the point is on the inside of at least one of the spaces.

outputs.name: Indices
outputs.info: Indices of all spaces which contain the point.

components.summary: 判断点是否落在一组平面界定的半空间内。

components.author: AndyP
components.name: Mesh Containment
components.info: Determine whether a point is contained inside one or more closed meshes.

inputs.name: Meshes
inputs.info: Meshes to include in the search.

inputs.name: Strict
inputs.info: If true, the inclusion is strict.

outputs.name: Inside
outputs.info: True if the point is on the inside of at least one of the meshes.

outputs.name: Indices
outputs.info: Indices of all meshes which contain the point.

components.summary: 判断点是否落在一个或多个封闭网格内部。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Pipe Containment
components.info: Determine whether a point is contained inside one or more implied curve pipes.

inputs.name: Strict
inputs.info: If true, the inclusion is strict.

outputs.name: Inside
outputs.info: True if the point is on the inside of at least one of the pipes.

outputs.name: Indices
outputs.info: Indices of all pipes which contain the point.

components.summary: 判断点是否落在曲线隐含的管体内。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Region Containment
components.info: Determine whether a point is contained inside one or more planar regions.

inputs.name: Regions
inputs.info: Regions to include in the search.

inputs.name: Strict
inputs.info: If true, then the inclusion is strict.

outputs.name: Inside
outputs.info: True if the point is on the inside of at least one of the regions.

outputs.name: Indices
outputs.info: Indices of all regions which contain the point.

components.summary: 判断点是否落在一个或多个平面区域内。

components.author: AndyP
components.name: Shape In Surface
components.info: Determine whether a shape is contained inside a closed surface.

outputs.name: Relationship
outputs.info: Relationship of shape to surface.

components.summary: 判断形状是否落在封闭曲面内部。

components.author: AndyP
components.name: Surface Containment
components.info: Determine whether a point is contained inside one or more closed surfaces.

inputs.name: Surfaces
inputs.info: Surfaces to include in the search.

inputs.name: Strict
inputs.info: If true, the inclusion is strict.

outputs.name: Inside
outputs.info: True if the point is on the inside of at least one of the surfaces.

outputs.name: Indices
outputs.info: Indices of all surfaces which contain the point.

components.summary: 判断点是否落在一个或多个封闭曲面内部。

components.author: AndyP
components.name: Isovist 2D
components.info: Compute an isovist by casting sample rays radially around a plane.

inputs.name: Plane
inputs.info: Plane encoding the location and orientation of the observer.

inputs.name: Radius
inputs.info: Optional maximum sampling radius. If omitted, the largest meaningful radius is picked and all hit-less rays are omitted from the outputs.

inputs.name: Obstacles
inputs.info: Ray obstacles. May incluce curves, planes, surfaces, and meshes.

inputs.name: Mode
inputs.info: Ray casting accuracy. Accurate uses exact surface intersections; Fast meshes surfaces for speed.

outputs.name: Points
outputs.info: Point where each sample ray stops, either at an obstacle hit or at the horizon.

outputs.name: Rays
outputs.info: Ray vector from the origin to each sample point.

outputs.name: Distances
outputs.info: Distance from the origin to each sample point.

outputs.name: Indices
outputs.info: Index of the obstacle hit by each ray, or -1 if no obstacle was hit.

components.summary: 在平面上向四周投射采样射线，计算视域范围。

components.author: AndyP
components.name: Isovist 3D
components.info: Compute an isovist by casting sample rays spherically around a location.

inputs.name: Plane
inputs.info: Sampling plane and origin. For a hemisphere the plane is the horizon and rays are cast above it.

inputs.name: Obstacles
inputs.info: Obstacles to sample against (curves, planes, surfaces and meshes are supported).

inputs.name: Domain
inputs.info: Whether to sample the upper hemisphere or the full sphere of directions.

inputs.name: Mode
inputs.info: Ray casting accuracy. Accurate uses exact surface intersections; Fast meshes surfaces for speed.

outputs.name: Points
outputs.info: Point where each sample ray stops, either at an intersection or at the horizon.

outputs.name: Rays
outputs.info: Ray vector from the origin to each sample point.

outputs.name: Distances
outputs.info: Distance from the origin to each sample point.

outputs.name: Indices
outputs.info: Index of the obstacle hit by each ray, or -1 if no obstacle was hit.

components.summary: 在空间中以球面方向投射射线，计算视域。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Isovist Coverage
components.info: Compute coverage and visibility statistics for a collection of isovist rays.

inputs.name: Rays
inputs.info: Isovist rays. Use the Rays output of an Isovist 2D or Isovist 3D component.

outputs.name: Coverage
outputs.info: Fraction of the original sampling dome occupied by rays that hit an obstacle.

outputs.name: Hits
outputs.info: Number of rays that hit an obstacle.

outputs.name: Mininum Distance
outputs.info: Smallest visible distance among hit rays, or zero if there were no hits.

outputs.name: Mean Distance
outputs.info: Average visible distance among hit rays, or zero if there were no hits.

outputs.name: Maximum Distance
outputs.info: Largest visible distance among hit rays, or zero if there were no hits.

outputs.name: Distance Deviation
outputs.info: Standard deviation of visible distance among hit rays, or zero if there were no hits.

components.summary: 统计一组视域射线的覆盖与可见性指标。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Isovist Extent
components.info: Compute the area (2D) or volume (3D) of an isovist, optionally with a distance falloff.

inputs.name: Rays
inputs.info: Isovist rays. Use the Rays output of an Isovist 2D or Isovist 3D component.

inputs.name: Weight
inputs.info: Distance falloff applied to each ray's contribution.

inputs.name: Transition
inputs.info: Transition distance where the falloff begins to take effect. Ignored for Block.

inputs.name: Normalise
inputs.info: If true, divide by the maximum possible extent at the sample horizon so the result is a unitless score. If false, report the absolute area or volume metrics.

outputs.name: Extent
outputs.info: Isovist area (2D) or volume (3D). With Normalise on, a unitless openness score in $[0,1]$; otherwise an absolute measure.

components.summary: 计算视域的面积（二维）或体积（三维），可加距离衰减。

components.author: AndyP
components.name: Isovist Field 2D
components.info: Create a scalar field whose value at each point is a planar isovist statistic.

inputs.name: Plane
inputs.info: Orientation of the sampling planes. The isovist at each queried point is cast on a plane parallel to this.

inputs.name: Count
inputs.info: Number of sample rays per isovist. Lower values evaluate faster when the field is sampled densely.

inputs.name: Obstacles
inputs.info: Obstacles to sample against (curves, planes, surfaces and meshes are supported).

inputs.name: Metric
inputs.info: Scalar metric reported at each query point.

inputs.name: Transition
inputs.info: Transition distance where the falloff begins. Ignored unless the metric is LinearRamp, Exponential or Smoothstep (or their normalised variants).

outputs.name: Field
outputs.info: Scalar field of the selected isovist metric at each point.

components.summary: 生成标量场，其值代表各点的平面视域指标。

components.author: AndyP
components.name: Isovist Field 3D
components.info: Create a scalar field whose value at each point is a spherical isovist statistic.

inputs.name: Plane
inputs.info: Sampling orientation. For a hemisphere the plane normal is the up axis and the plane is the horizon.

inputs.name: Count
inputs.info: Number of sample rays per isovist. Lower values evaluate faster when the field is sampled densely.

inputs.name: Obstacles
inputs.info: Obstacles to sample against (curves, planes, surfaces and meshes are supported).

inputs.name: Domain
inputs.info: Whether to sample the upper hemisphere or the full sphere of directions.

inputs.name: Metric
inputs.info: Scalar metric reported at each query point.

inputs.name: Transition
inputs.info: Transition distance where the falloff begins. Ignored unless the metric is LinearRamp, Exponential or Smoothstep (or their normalised variants).

outputs.name: Field
outputs.info: Scalar field of the selected isovist metric at each point.

components.summary: 生成标量场，其值代表各点的球面视域指标。

components.author: AndyP
components.name: Isovist Ray
components.info: Compute a single isovist sample by casting one ray into a collection of obstacles.

inputs.name: Sample
inputs.info: Sampling ray. Its start is the origin and its direction the cast direction.

inputs.name: Obstacles
inputs.info: Obstacles to sample against (curves, planes, surfaces and meshes are supported).

inputs.name: Mode
inputs.info: Ray casting accuracy. Accurate uses exact surface intersections; Fast meshes surfaces for speed.

outputs.name: Point
outputs.info: Point where the sample ray stops, either at an intersection or at the horizon.

outputs.name: Ray
outputs.info: Ray vector from the origin to the sample point.

outputs.name: Distance
outputs.info: Distance from the origin to the sample point.

outputs.name: Index
outputs.info: Index of the obstacle hit, or -1 if no obstacle was hit.

components.summary: 向一组障碍物投射单条射线，得到一个视域采样。
